Checker state stores

Source: R/refresh.R
state_file.Rd

keep_fresh() passes a state store to checker so it can remember things between checks (e.g. what was installed last time, to skip a remote check). state_file() persists state in a single RDS file; state_memory() keeps it for the current session only.

Usage

state_file(path)

state_memory()

Arguments

path

character(1) or function Path to the RDS file, or a function returning it (evaluated on each read and write, so the location can follow e.g. an environment variable). Created on first write.

Value

FreshState An R6 object with get(name, default = NULL), set(name, value), reset(), and a read-only path (NULL for state_memory()).

Details

To store state elsewhere (e.g. a database), subclass FreshState and override its private load() and save() methods, or supply any object with get(name, default = NULL), set(name, value), and reset() methods.
